output.one_liner: Open source API development ecosystem for developers to test, document, and collaborate on APIs.
output.description: Hoppscotch is a lightweight, open-source API development ecosystem that enables developers to send requests, view responses, and collaborate in real time. It supports REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, and more, with features like environments, collections, and team workspaces.

icp.pain: Manual API testing is slow and error-prone; existing tools are heavy or lack collaboration
icp.buying_trigger: Need for faster, collaborative, and open-source API testing

differentiators: Supports multiple protocols (REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, SSE, MQTT)
Open source with PWA and desktop apps
Built-in proxy to bypass CORS and access HTTP endpoints
proof_points: Available as PWA and desktop apps (from README)
Team collaboration with role-based access (from README)

voice.sample_phrase: Helps you create requests faster, saving precious time on development.

gaps: No testimonials or user quotes on site

confidence.notes: High confidence; data from live site and GitHub repo. Pricing page missing.
